## Certificate of Visa Eligibility application for P1

Copy the entries by field number. Complete each `NEEDS-YOU` item by hand using the notes below. Write text entries in block letters, as the form instructs.

```text
1. PERSONAL DETAILS
B01  SURNAME_P1
B02  GIVEN_P1
     MIDDLE_P1
B03  NEEDS-YOU
B04  Check Male
B05  DATE_P1
B06  INDIAN
B07  PLACE_P1
B08  NEEDS-YOU
B09  NEEDS-YOU
B10  NEEDS-YOU

2. PASSPORT INFORMATION
B11  NEEDS-YOU
B12  ID_P1
B13  INDIA
B14  NEEDS-YOU
B15  ISSUED_P1
B16  2029/06/04
B17  NEEDS-YOU

3. CONTACT INFORMATION
B18  NEEDS-YOU
B19  ADDRESS_P1
B20  PHONE_P1
B21  NEEDS-YOU
B22  NEEDS-YOU
B23  GIVEN_P2
     SURNAME_P2
B24  UNITED KINGDOM
B25  PHONE_P2
B26  WIFE

4. MARITAL STATUS AND FAMILY DETAILS
B27  Check Married
B28  SURNAME_P2
B29  GIVEN_P2
B30  DATE_P2
B31  INDIAN
B32  ADDRESS_P1
B33  PHONE_P2
B34  Check Yes and enter 1

5. EDUCATION
B35  Check Master's / Doctoral Degree
B36  NEEDS-YOU
B37  NEEDS-YOU

6. EMPLOYMENT
B38  Check Employed
B39  NEEDS-YOU
B40  NEEDS-YOU
B41  NEEDS-YOU
B42  NEEDS-YOU
```

### Adjust these entries by hand

- **B02** Combine the restored names in the one Given Names blank. Match the passport’s Given Names field exactly, including the middle name only if it appears there.
- **B05 and B30** Rewrite each restored birth date as `yyyy/mm/dd`. **B15** Use the same format for the passport issue date to match the expiry date above.
- **B07** Enter only the country from the restored birthplace. If it lists only a city or region, fill in the country yourself.
- **B19 and B32** I’ve treated the saved home address as the UK residence you share. Use it in both fields if it is that address.
- **B20 and B21** Use the restored phone number in B20 if it is your mobile. If it is your landline, put it in B21 and supply your mobile in B20.
- **B23** Combine the two restored names in the single Full Name blank, using your wife’s full English name.

### Supply the missing information

| Field | What to supply |
|---|---|
| B03 | Your name in Chinese characters, if applicable. |
| B08 | Your national identity number, if applicable. |
| B09 | Whether you ever entered or departed Korea under another name. If yes, supply the family and given names used. |
| B10 | Whether you hold another citizenship. If yes, supply the details. |
| B11 | Your passport category. Check Regular if it is an ordinary passport. If you check Other, specify the type. |
| B14 | The place of issue shown in your passport. |
| B17 | Whether you hold another valid passport. If yes, supply its type, number, issuing country, and expiry date. |
| B18 | Your home-country address in India, if applicable. |
| B21–B22 | Your landline number, if you have one, and your email address. |
| B36–B37 | The school that awarded your master’s degree and its city, province or equivalent, and country. |
| B39–B42 | Your employer’s name, your job title, and the employer’s address and telephone number. |
